pricing.title: Operator pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when the requests flow.

items.a: Always with the operator. JetMarket is a marketplace, not a broker — we match requests to operators and take a success fee from them when a deal closes.

items.q: What does it cost me as a buyer?
items.a: Nothing. Requesting quotes is free; operators pay the platform.
A repositioning flight an aircraft flies anyway — sold at a deep discount when it matches your route.
Operators self-declare their fleet and credentials; our team verifies documentation manually. Unverified operators are marked and receive RFQs with a delay.

items.q: Can I buy an aircraft here?
items.a: Yes — aircraft_sale listings accept RFQs like any other; success fee on closed sales is 1.5%.

0.q: Do I need any API keys to run this?
0.a: No. Every provider ships a mock implementation — the app runs and is fully demoable offline.

1.a: Fill the real keys into your env file and switch the *_PROVIDER variables from mock. See GO_LIVE.template.md.

2.a: Yes — edit packages/ui/tokens.css. Colors, radii and typography cascade through every primitive and block.
